description: Approved cadastral Vicmap Parcel source for Melbourne; distinct from Vicmap Property polygons.
sourceScope: Victoria cadastral parcel map polygons; distinct from local-government property assessment units. Other Australian states use separate datasets. Only Approved (A) parcel and version records are ground; Proposed (P) records are excluded. Crown and government-road parcels remain included. Only G (unrestricted ground) and S (ground surface affected by strata) levels are ground; above/below strata are excluded.

statusEvidence.scope: Official Vicmap catalogue says product contains registered and proposed parcels; DataVic parcel-table metadata says it includes both freehold and Crown parcels. To render current cadastral ground, include only approved A status in parcel_status and parv_status; retain Crown-status categories to represent complete cadastre. A is labeled Approved in lookup, so do not overstate it as a distinct legal registration indicator.
statusEvidence.doNotUseParcelRegDateAsRegisteredFilter: Statewide, parcel_status A with parcel_reg_date NULL count 1,029,582; A with a registration date count 3,155,189; all P rows (121,719) had null parcel_reg_date. Thus requiring non-null registration date would drop many approved current rows.

completeCbdSample.overlapCheck: Local positive-area geometry intersections (Turf clipping) against all approved A geometries in the complete bbox: each of the six proposed PFIs overlaps at least one approved polygon. Examples: proposed 458838252 intersects approved 216457672 by ~774.696 m2; 460411895 intersects 216457672 by ~30.819 m2. Exclude P to avoid proposed geometry overlying current approved fabric.

statusEvidence.recommendedFilter: parcel_status = 'A' AND parv_status = 'A' (exclude proposed P; do not use parcel_reg_date for registration filtering; do not restrict Crown status for full-cadastre scope).

verification.forcedTinyPages: Two verification attempts with pageSize=3 timed out after 15 seconds. Normal pageSize=2000 viewport, IDs, footprint and binding succeeded; failure remains an error, not a cached absence.

browser.scope: Final approved G/S surface-level filter; viewport and authoritative binding reverified.
